coverage_note: The introduction, S 10, and the conclusion. The pass records a finding that governs the whole file: in this commentary 'constitution' is almost always the onto-theo-logical constitution of metaphysics - a Heideggerian Verfassung, the make-up or set-up of metaphysics - and not Husserlian Konstitution. Nothing in the text marks the difference. SS 1-9 and 11-25 have not been extracted; three of the longest of them carry no term of the family at all and two are recorded as absences.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, pp. 6-8
units.claim: Seen through the prism of onto-theo-logical constitution, even the ostensibly non-metaphysical texts of the corpus release the constituted and constitutive elements of a metaphysics.
units.quote: seen through the prism of onto-theo-logical constitution, even the ostensibly non-metaphysical texts of the corpus release, like primitive colours, the constituted and constitutive elements of a metaphysics.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, introduction
units.claim: If the onto-theo-logical constitution strictly delimits the Cartesian constitution of metaphysics, it fixes that constitution's limits and in closing it opens the possibility of its overcoming.
units.quote: if the onto-theo-logical constitution strictly delimits the Cartesian constitution of metaphysics, then it fixes that constitution's limits; and in closing it, it opens the possibility of its overcoming.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, introduction
units.claim: The onto-theo-logical model is used to test how Descartes constitutes himself according to a figure of onto-theo-logy, and reciprocally to subject the model to a test.
units.quote: the point is not to impose it on Descartes but to use it to test how Descartes constitutes himself according to a figure of onto-theo-logy

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes S 10
units.claim: Not one figure of the onto-theo-logical constitution has been found in Descartes but two, one according to cogitatio and one according to causa.
units.quote: not one figure of the constitution has been found but two, one according to *cogitatio* and one according to *causa*.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes S 10
units.claim: The proliferation of figures is said possibly to cast doubt on the operative rigour of the concept of onto-theo-logical constitution itself.
units.quote: should the proliferation not simply cast doubt on the operative rigour of the concept of onto-theo-logical constitution itself, and even on the imprudently univocal notion of *the* metaphysic

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes S 10
units.claim: The onto-theo-logical constitution is posited to impose itself on Heidegger's thought from the two figures of metaphysics that put it most massively into evidence, Leibniz and Hegel.
units.quote: Marion posits that the onto-theo-logical constitution imposes itself on Heidegger's thought from the two figures of metaphysics that put it most massively into evidence and into operation, Leibniz and Hegel.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, pp. 373-374
units.claim: Descartes complicates the onto-theo-logical constitution in redoubling it, and that complexification forces a decision between two hypotheses about the essence of the constitution.
units.quote: Descartes complicates the onto-theo-logical constitution in redoubling it. That complexification imposes deciding between two hypotheses about the essence of the constitution.

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, p. 374
units.claim: On the second hypothesis, the Cartesian redoubling reveals and deepens the essence of the onto-theo-logical constitution, of which Heidegger formulated only an elementary outline.
units.quote: the Cartesian initiative of redoubling it reveals and deepens the essence of the onto-theo-logical constitution of metaphysics, of which Heidegger would have formulated only an elementary outline

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, p. 374
units.claim: Never has the onto-theo-logical constitution been so visible as in its Cartesian redoubling, precisely because it splits in two there.
units.quote: never has the onto-theo-logical constitution been so visible as in its Cartesian redoubling, precisely because it splits in two there

units.primary_locator: Sur le prisme metaphysique de Descartes, pp. 375-376
units.claim: Authenticated as a metaphysician by the onto-theo-logical constitution whose essence he discovers better in complicating it, Descartes nonetheless escapes it in part.
units.quote: Authenticated as a metaphysician by the onto-theo-logical constitution whose essence he discovers better in complicating it, Descartes nonetheless escapes it in part

absences.expected_because: The undoing of the ego and the decentring of the self is where a constituting subject would have to be met if the commentary read the Cartesian ego as one. Its 4,428 words carry no term of the family, in a commentary whose every other use of 'constitution' is the onto-theo-logical one.

The system of contradictions is the longest section of the commentary and works out the tensions of the two figures that S 10 calls two figures of the onto-theo-logical constitution. It carries no term of the family.
